categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and directly modifies REST endpoint handling in src/rest.cpp.
categories.rationale: Prevents unauthenticated REST requests from generating spurious disk corruption error logs. When querying `/rest/spenttxouts/<hash>` for blocks lacking undo data, the endpoint previously logged `[error] OpenUndoFile failed for FlatFilePos(nFile=-1, nPos=0)` before returning 404, causing false alarms for node operators.
